import os, sys, glob

base = "unpacked"
print("=== Files in unpacked ===")
for root, dirs, files in os.walk(base):
    for f in sorted(files):
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        print(p, os.path.getsize(p))

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), ".codex", "skills", "docx"))
try:
    from scripts.document import Document
except Exception as e:
    print("Document import failed:", e)
    sys.exit(0)

doc = Document("unpacked")
editor = doc["word/document.xml"]
paras = editor.dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
print("\n=== Paragraph count:", len(paras), "===")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild:
            texts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    # check for style
    style = ""
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr")
    if pPr and pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle"):
        style = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")[0].getAttribute("w:val")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    print(f"[{i}] style={style!r} text={txt!r}")

"""Add a RECOMMENDATIONS section to the unpacked quarterly report."""
import defusedxml.minidom as minidom

XML_PATH = "unpacked/word/document.xml"
NS = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

dom = minidom.parse(XML_PATH)

def make_para(text=""):
    """Build a <w:p> matching the document's formatting (Helvetica Light, sz 24)."""
    p = dom.createElement("w:p")
    pPr = dom.createElement("w:pPr")
    p.appendChild(pPr)
    r = dom.createElement("w:r")
    rPr = dom.createElement("w:rPr")
    rFonts = dom.createElement("w:rFonts")
    rFonts.setAttribute("w:ascii", "Helvetica Light")
    rFonts.setAttribute("w:hAnsi", "Helvetica Light")
    rFonts.setAttribute("w:cs", "Helvetica Light")
    rPr.appendChild(rFonts)
    sz = dom.createElement("w:sz")
    sz.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    rPr.appendChild(sz)
    szCs = dom.createElement("w:sz-cs")
    szCs.setAttribute("w:val", "24")
    rPr.appendChild(szCs)
    r.appendChild(rPr)
    t = dom.createElement("w:t")
    t.setAttribute("xml:space", "preserve")
    t.appendChild(dom.createTextNode(text))
    r.appendChild(t)
    p.appendChild(r)
    return p

body = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:body")[0]
sect_pr = body.getElementsByTagName("w:sectPr")[0]

new_paras = [
    make_para("RECOMMENDATIONS"),
    make_para(),
    make_para("Based on Q4 2024 results and the Q1 2025 outlook, we recommend the following actions:"),
    make_para(),
    make_para("\u2022 Prioritize Cloud Services capacity and sales enablement investment to build on its 22.8% YoY growth, the strongest of all business segments."),
    make_para("\u2022 Increase R&D focus on AI-driven product enhancements while holding R&D spend near 12.8% of revenue to preserve margins."),
    make_para("\u2022 Continue cost discipline in cost of revenue and general & administrative to sustain operating margins above 23%."),
    make_para("\u2022 Accelerate international expansion to support the 10-13% revenue growth outlook for Q1 2025, leveraging improved marketing efficiency."),
]

for p in new_paras:
    body.insertBefore(p, sect_pr)

# Save, preferring the original ascii encoding; fall back to utf-8 if needed
try:
    content = dom.toxml(encoding="ascii")
    used = "ascii"
except UnicodeEncodeError:
    content = dom.toxml(encoding="utf-8")
    used = "utf-8"

with open(XML_PATH, "wb") as f:
    f.write(content)
print("Saved document.xml with encoding:", used)
